name: Logicoo Form Marketing & Automation
author: logicoo

sections.description:
Add-on for the Logicoo Form plugin. It sends the contacts of your forms to Mailchimp, Brevo, Mailjet, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot and Kit, after each submission and without making the visitor wait.

Requires Logicoo Form 1.6.2 or later. With an older Logicoo Form the add-on does not start and shows a notice. Each service needs its own account, and its plan and limits are decided by that service.

Connections

  • Connect one or more accounts of each service under Logicoo Form > Integrations, with the API key or token of the service.
  • Credentials are stored encrypted and are never shown again after saving. Verify a connection at any time.
  • Several connections per service, each with its own name: useful when a site works for more than one client or brand.

Actions in the form builder

  • Turn on “Email marketing” per form and add up to 20 actions. Each one has its own connection, list, fields, conditions and consent, and a failure in one does not stop the others.
  • Map form fields, parts of a field, fixed values and submission data to the standard and custom fields of the service, with the right type for numbers, dates and yes/no values. Only what you map leaves your site, and File, Signature and Password fields can never be mapped.
  • Choose whether a contact is created or updated, only created, or only updated, and whether an empty answer clears the value in the service.
  • Add and remove tags, groups and lists where the service allows it. A tag or a list can also depend on an answer, through a table of values.
  • Send an action only when its conditions are met, with the same conditions as Logicoo Form notifications, evaluated on the server.
  • Create one contact per row of a repeating group.
  • Results published by other add-ons, such as the score or outcome from Logicoo Form Quizzes & Scoring, can be mapped to a field, used in conditions and used to choose tags.
  • A summary shows exactly what each action sends, and you can send a test contact before saving the form.

Consent

  • A subscription needs a consent field that you choose, with the answer that means “yes”. Consent is never assumed.
  • Double opt-in where the service offers it: Mailchimp, Brevo and Kit.
  • A contact who has unsubscribed, bounced or been blocked is never subscribed again by a form.
  • Actions can wait until an entry is confirmed, for example until a payment is completed.

Reliable delivery

  • The entry is always saved first, and the visitor sees the same message whether the service answers or not.
  • Contacts go through a background queue. Temporary errors are retried up to six times at growing intervals, and when a service limits the requests only that service waits.
  • If a key is revoked, the connection is marked with an error and its contacts wait until a new verification succeeds.

For site owners

  • The result of each action in the entry detail, a status column and a filter in Entries.
  • Sync existing entries or retry failed ones in bulk from Entries, or retry all the failed contacts of a connection from Integrations.
  • A diagnostic log kept for 30 days, with no email addresses and no form values, and an optional debug mode that turns itself off after 24 hours.
  • A Site Health check for each connection.
  • Exporting personal data includes the sync results, and a suggested text for your privacy policy lists the services you use.
  • Accessible builder panel. No tracking or telemetry. Translations from translate.wordpress.org.

Deleting a form entry, or erasing a person’s data with the WordPress privacy tools, removes the add-on’s record of that entry from this site. It does not delete the contact from the email marketing service: delete the contact in the service.

External services

The add-on contacts a service only after you connect it in Logicoo Form → Integrations and enable an email marketing action on a form. Nothing is sent from the visitor’s browser: the site sends the data in the background, after the entry is saved. Only the fields you map in the action are sent.

Mailchimp (https://.api.mailchimp.com, for example us21.api.mailchimp.com; the data center is the end of your API key)

  • When: when you save or verify a Mailchimp connection (account check), when the form builder loads the audiences, merge fields, tags and interest groups of a Mailchimp connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with a Mailchimp action (member lookup, then creation or update, and tags).
  • What: your Mailchimp API key in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped fields, the chosen interest groups and tags.
  • Terms: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/

Brevo (https://api.brevo.com)

  • When: when you save or verify a Brevo connection (lists and account check), when the form builder loads the lists and contact attributes of a Brevo connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with a Brevo action (contact lookup, then creation or update, or a double opt-in request).
  • What: your Brevo API key in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped fields and the chosen lists.
  • Terms: https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

Mailjet (https://api.mailjet.com)

  • When: when you save or verify a Mailjet connection (lists and profile check), when the form builder loads the contact lists and contact properties of a Mailjet connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with a Mailjet action (contact lookup, then creation or update and lists).
  • What: your Mailjet API key and secret key in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped properties and the chosen lists.
  • Terms: https://www.mailjet.com/legal/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.mailjet.com/legal/privacy-policy/

ActiveCampaign (https://.api-us1.com or https://.activehosted.com: the API URL of your account, shown in ActiveCampaign under Settings → Developer)

  • When: when you save or verify an ActiveCampaign connection (list check), when the form builder loads the lists, custom fields and tags of an ActiveCampaign connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with an ActiveCampaign action (contact lookup, then creation or update, lists and tags).
  • What: your ActiveCampaign API token in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped fields, the chosen lists and tags.
  • Terms: https://www.activecampaign.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://www.activecampaign.com/legal/privacy-policy

HubSpot (https://api.hubapi.com)

  • When: when you save or verify a HubSpot connection (subscription types and account check), when the form builder loads the subscription types, contact properties and static lists of a HubSpot connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with a HubSpot action (contact and subscription status lookup, then creation or update, subscription with its legal basis, and lists).
  • What: your HubSpot service key or private app token in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped properties, the chosen subscription type and lists.
  • Terms: https://legal.hubspot.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://legal.hubspot.com/privacy-policy

Kit, formerly ConvertKit (https://api.kit.com)

  • When: when you save or verify a Kit connection (form and account check), when the form builder loads the forms, custom fields and tags of a Kit connection (kept for 12 hours, or until you press “Refresh”), when you send a test contact from the form builder (the email address you enter, fixed values, the form title and the date), and after each submission of a form with a Kit action (subscriber lookup, then creation or update, addition to the chosen form, and tags).
  • What: your Kit API key in the request header; the contact’s email address, the mapped fields, the chosen form and tags.
  • Terms: https://kit.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://kit.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Logicoo Form plugin (1.6.2 or later).
  2. Install and activate this add-on.
  3. Under Logicoo Form > Integrations, add a connection with the API key or token of your service.
  4. Edit a form, turn on “Email marketing” and add an action: choose the connection, the list, the email field and the consent field.
  5. Send a test contact from the panel, save the form and try a real submission.
sections.faq:
Is the visitor slowed down by the service?

No. The entry is saved first and the contact is sent in the background. No script or request to the services is added to your pages.

What happens if the service is down?

The entry is safe. Temporary errors are tried up to six times, over about nine hours. After that you can retry from Entries or from Integrations.

Do I need a consent checkbox?

For a subscription, yes: the add-on does not send a subscription without the consent field you chose. An action that only updates an existing contact can run without it, and the builder reminds you that the legal basis remains your responsibility.

Can a form subscribe someone who has unsubscribed?

No. A contact who has unsubscribed, bounced or been blocked is left as they are, and the log records it.

Does it work when WP-Cron is limited?

The queue uses WordPress scheduling. On a site where WP-Cron is disabled, use a system cron job or the wp logicoo-form jobs run command.

Are my API keys safe?

They are stored encrypted, using a key from wp-config.php, and they are never shown again or included in form exports. Deleting a connection deletes its credentials, and uninstalling the add-on always removes them.

What happens when I uninstall the add-on?

Its connections, settings, queue and log are removed, unless you choose to keep the data under Integrations > Settings. The credentials are removed in any case. Contacts already sent stay in the service.
